issues.on_page: Depreciation Fund 'Transfer from General Fund' 240,000 (p10); GF schedule 8000 Interfund transfers only 38,500 (p9)
issues.issue: Extractor assumption: the 240,000 transfer is hidden in General Fund spending lines and placed against the instruction group. The page doesn't print this. It is supported by arithmetic: schedule instruction-type lines 2,902,120 + Employee Benefit 18,750 - 240,000 = statement Instruction 2,680,870, and every other function ties exactly. Contra and other-financing lines are both marked split_from/review.

issues.on_page: Interest 88,717 (includes GF 1140 Interest on taxes 8,310, p6)
issues.issue: The statement line mixes investment interest with 8,310 interest on property taxes, which the rules put under property tax. The dominant category was used, and the line is marked review.

issues.on_page: Depreciation Fund: Support services - business / Capital outlay 20,000
issues.issue: The governmental funds statement counts this 20,000 under Student transportation (290,014 = GF 2700 lines 270,014 + 20,000), not Capital outlay, so the detail function doesn't tie to the statement's function lines. The line is marked review.
